doctrine: Different domains are not different roots; they are licensed projections of one root process: constrained distinguishability. This is queue item 1 of the Ratchet Runbook (system_v6/foundations/ratchet_runbook_DRAFT_20260615.md). This is the MAPPER pass only (runbook role 1). The Minimalist/Lift-Advocate/Control-Auditor adjudication of contested rows (forced vs installed, load-bearing vs ornamental) is the multi-model fleet step, NOT done here.

rows.name: entropy
rows.preserves: how many distinctions remain, are hidden, or are erased
rows.stronger_lifts: block/basin entropy, von-Neumann entropy (only if density forced), fiber residual, cut entropy

rows.name: geometry
rows.preserves: adjacency / relation structure among surviving classes
rows.erases: anything not expressible as relation among current classes
rows.stronger_lifts: nested survivor structure, tensor/cut/correlation geometry, smooth manifold (late)

rows.name: QCA
rows.preserves: locality, update order, finite transition structure
rows.weakest_carrier: finite support + ordered local update (ring-checkerboard run-surface)
rows.stronger_lifts: unitary QCA, channel layer, spinor/Hopf carrier
rows.forced_or_installed: the update family is SUPPLIED, not forced by the quotient (rung-0 fleet)

rows.name: Hopfield
rows.preserves: attractor/basin structure, recall, terminal vs transient
rows.erases: off-basin transients; fine distinctions inside a basin
rows.stronger_lifts: quantum Hopfield memory, CPTP/Lindblad attractor basins

rows.name: QIT
rows.preserves: subsystem/cut structure, channel action, mutual/coherent information
rows.erases: anything below the chosen cut resolution
rows.stronger_lifts: density/operator ρ (only if forced), cut-correlation geometry
rows.forced_or_installed: ρ is INSTALLED, not forced by finite probe data (rung-0 fleet, 7/7)

rows.name: spinor
rows.preserves: local frame, hidden phase, path history, orientation, chirality, lift, quotient-erased distinctions
rows.erases: nothing above the quotient; it is the lift that the quotient erased
rows.weakest_carrier: psi in C^2 on S^3 (only admitted when quotient-erased distinctions are load-bearing)
controls: two public readouts match but path/phase/chirality differ under future probes
rows.forced_or_installed: lift admitted ONLY when the quotient-erased distinction is load-bearing (spinor_quotient_freedom_discriminator target)

rows.name: dictionary
rows.preserves: named distinctions agreed within an org/community
rows.erases: distinctions not in the lexicon; private/local distinctions
rows.weakest_carrier: finite set of named claims over a support
rows.stronger_lifts: nested org dictionaries, governance over definition changes

rows.name: OpenHR
rows.erases: the person behind the public credential/score (carrier vs quotient)
rows.stronger_lifts: skill-claim admission, peer audit, proof exchange
controls: merge graph nodes by similarity only
rows.forced_or_installed: social projection; public score = quotient readout, not root identity

rows.name: OpenFinance
rows.erases: the company operating reality behind the KPI
rows.stronger_lifts: peer audit, repair session, financial-view lease, proof exchange

rows.name: LevOS
rows.erases: whatever was not admitted via proof/receipt
rows.stronger_lifts: semantic-control evaluator, agent-lease policy, flow runtime
rows.forced_or_installed: separate product track; imports the math as 'never confuse quotient with carrier'
